result:
The generated C# matches the spec exactly. All three operations are implemented:

- **`RecordDelete`** — upserts `name|stamp` into the tombstone only when the existing stamp is `< stamp` (i.e. leaves the file unchanged when an entry exists with stamp `≥ stamp`, correctly handling absence via `IndexStamp`'s `-1`).
- **`SyncTwoWay`** — phase 1 walks source entries in source order; phase 2 walks target entries filtered to those absent from source (the target-only set, unaffected by phase 1 so order/membership match the start state). For each: `d ≥ m` deletes from every index where present (each a counted action), else newer-wins upserts into target (`s>t`) or source (`t>s`), equal is a no-op. The tombstone is only read.
- **`SyncWithPolicy`** — delegates to `SyncTwoWay` when `twoWay`, else to the original `Sync` (which never touches the tombstone).

Existing behavior is untouched, index invariants and the `fs:rw` effect declarations are preserved, and the project builds cleanly with 0 warnings/errors.
